_doc: Staged instrument data for the case-study chart rollout. Pulled 2026-08-31 via Executor (Peec AI + Google Search Console). This file is the reviewed source the Sanity population step reads — nothing goes into Sanity that is not in here. All series are RAW measured values; indexing to a baseline happens at population time so the baseline choice stays visible. Eligibility rules applied: movement >= ~1.8x (or rank improvement >= 1.0), series >= 6 points, engines all non-zero in the after-window, claims must reconcile with the published page.

eligible.indexedTrend: NO — FAILS THE MOVEMENT RULE. Clicks Sep 2025 -> Aug 2026 are 0.67x (265 -> 177, with a Feb crash to 96 still recovering). Charting the recovery window alone would be cherry-picking. No Google board; the case study is an AI story anyway.

Published 32.71% is within a partial-week wobble of the measured 30.5%; align the wording at population.
